name: Mashin Sentai Kiramager
description: After the kingdom of Crystalia is plunged into a deep darkness by Yodonheim, the army of darkness. Princess Mabushina, comes to Earth with the Kiramai Stones to find individuals with strong "shining spirits" to become the Kiramagers and fight against the Yodonheim Army.

videos.title: Sparkling Movie Volume 1
videos.overview: A web-exclusive YouTube specials focusing on transforming into a Kiramager and the team's Kiramental energy.

videos.title: Sparkling Movie Volume 2
videos.overview: A web-exclusive YouTube specials focusing on transforming into a Kiramager and the team's Kiramental energy.

videos.title: Episodes 1 & 2 Unreleased Cut, Warehouse Release, Start Dash Once Again SP
videos.overview: This is a special for Mashin Sentai Kiramager. It features unreleased cuts from episodes 1 and 2. Juru finally becomes Kiramai Red, and the five become one team of Kiramagers, in a never before seen version with unreleased scenes! Kiramai Silver makes a brief cameo at the end of the special.

videos.title: Dazzle Talk! The Partner-Loving Machines
videos.overview: This is the first episode of the Mashin Sentai Kiramager Dazzle Talk! special. The Shiny Breaker makes a brief appearance at the end of the special

videos.title: Dazzle Talk! This Battle is Amazing!!
videos.overview: This is the second and final episode of the Machine Sentai Kiramager Dazzle Talk! special. Takamichi Crystalia, Kiramai Sliver's identity, makes a brief appearance at the end of this special.

videos.title: Garza and Crunchula's Calamentality Research
videos.overview: This special features unreleased footage cut from episodes 7 and 8.

videos.title: Mashin Folktale Theater
videos.overview: This is a special anime short for Mashin Sentai Kiramager.

videos.title: Everybody Dance Transformed! Kiramei Dance
videos.overview: The Kiramagers and friends transform and dance to their season's ending theme, "Kiraful Miracle Kiramager".

videos.title: Wonder Sparkling Movie
videos.overview: The third volume of the Mashin Sentai Kiramager: Sparkling Movies web transofrmation lesson specials.

videos.title: Kiramager Henshin Series & Kiraful Go Arrow CM
The Mashin Are Born!
videos.overview: After conquering planet Crystalia, the Yodonheim army begins their invasion of Earth. Meanwhile, the Kiramagers look for their fifth and final member until they meet Juru Atsuta, a young artist with a burning passion for drawing.

videos.title: Leader Certification
videos.overview: Mabushina and most of the Kiramagers welcome a surprised Juru with open arms as their fifth member and leader, but Sena isn't so sure about him yet. The Yodon Army launches their invasion and sends a Jamenshi to attack the city and challenge the Kiramagers to a hellish version of rugby.

videos.title: The Vice Guy! No Advice Needed
videos.overview: After battling the Vice Jamen, Shiguru finds himself with a vice stuck on his head. Despite this, however, Shiguru returns to set without saying a word, with the other Kiramagers having to make sure he is truly okay.

videos.title: The Princess of the Lost Kingdom
videos.overview: Mabushiina's uncle arrives with news that the King is not dead, but the Kiramager are not as quick to trust him.

videos.title: Shovellow Coming Through!
videos.overview: Shovellow schemes a plan to make Tametomo leader of the Kiramager; three Kirama Stones are found on Earth.

videos.title: My Friend Turned Five
videos.overview: Shiguru and Sena get trapped by a camera monster when Sayo loses her memory of everything after five-years-old, forcing Juuru and Tametomo to fight alone.

videos.title: Training for You
videos.overview: The other Kiramager all come up with the same idea to train Juuru, leaving him exhausted when a pair of bickering Jamenshi brothers show up.

videos.title: The Lightning Speed Express
videos.overview: Juuru passes out in the middle of a battle when he dreams of King Oladdin.

videos.title: The Karuta Path of My Youth
videos.overview: When an old friend of Sena shows up, a Karuta playing Jamenshi has a game for the Kiramager.

videos.title: The Girl Who Chases After Shiguru
videos.overview: Three of the Kiramager become obsessed with a popular idol when Shiguru notices that she bares a striking resemblance to a girl that he knows.

videos.title: Time Has Been Looped
videos.overview: After getting cursed by a man that he beat in a competition, Tametomo finds himself heading into battle over and over against the same monster.

videos.title: The Nice Guy With the Wonder Drill
videos.overview: Sayo is stranded in the mountains with a sprained ankle when she spots a man and asks him for help.

videos.title: The Great Underground Battle
videos.overview: Mabushiina doesn't want anything to do with her brother, who now only cares about treasure.

videos.title: The Solitary Ace
videos.overview: Juuru tries to help Takamichi, but Takamichi believes that he sparkles the most on his own.

videos.title: Listen to Takamichi's Voice
videos.overview: Everyone is ordered to not bother Shiguru while he is filming his current drama; Takamichi tries to make up with Mabushiina, but she leaves instead, getting caught in Kurantula's game.

videos.title: Marshmallow Royale
videos.overview: When a marshmallow monster attacks, it triggers a traumatic memory in Takamichi from high school.

videos.title: The Mansion's Rare Stone
videos.overview: Takamichi finds a house with a treasure challenge, and inside the house is a stone that's he's been looking for.

videos.title: Falling into Darkness
videos.overview: The Kiramager are all cautious around Mabushiina when Garuza takes control of the monstone in Takamichi.

videos.title: Partners
videos.overview: Juuru is having trouble with a young boy who won't draw in class when the Kiramager are called into battle and end up with switched bodies!

videos.title: A Dangerous Pair
videos.overview: Juuru gets called out of after school studies when a fellow student follows him and finds herself stuck in the battle.

videos.title: Fishing, Sometimes a Master
videos.overview: Shiguru is on the lookout for a monster that's been evading the Kiramager when Mabushiina collapses at the aquarium.

videos.title: Are You Ready? Hey You Witch!
videos.overview: In order to save Mabushiina, the Kiramager travel back in time to stop her from being cursed.

videos.title: Mabushina's Mother
videos.overview: Mabushiina learns that her mother is still alive, but her and Takamichi fear for her safety if she were to find out of the king's death.

videos.title: Let's Start a Band!
videos.overview: Sayo and some other doctors create a band to make a young child feel better about getting an operation.

videos.title: That Cute Shrine Maiden
videos.overview: Takamichi has a new dream that he wishes for and starts searching for the next Kanaema stone when Tametomo meets a cute shrine maiden on their trip.

videos.title: Make It an Arrow Weapon
videos.overview: Tametomo is offended by Yodonna's way of treating her subordinates, putting all his faith in Juuru to make them better.

videos.title: Runner in a Big Pinch
videos.overview: Sena is training with her sponsors at SCRTC when Yodonna turns that training against her.

videos.title: Shiguru Cries
videos.overview: Juuru has a different kind of dream with the king; Shiguru and Juuru ask an old Mashin friend of the king for help.

videos.title: Atamald of Illusions
videos.overview: The Kiramager ask to be taken to the land of Atamald to restore their Mashin to normal; Juuru is sure that the king's soul has not perished.

videos.title: The Proud Super Warrior
videos.overview: The Kiramager realize that they cannot call on the king whenever they want and so Muryou sets a plan into action.

videos.title: Toys
videos.overview: Juuru and Takamichi take Kirameijin and Gigant Driller to fight a monster when they end up shrunken down to the size of toys!

videos.title: There's Something About Sayo
videos.overview: The other Kiramager are super invested in Sayo's personal life when they are soon faced with a monster that love riddles.

videos.title: The Giant Monster Panic Clash!
videos.overview: A Sayo-less Kiramager prepare to go into battle as the king contacts Juuru to give him an urgent message.

videos.title: A Blue and Yellow Passion
videos.overview: Yodonna shows off her new accessory from Crystalia when Shiguru takes a hit meant for Tametomo.

videos.title: A Wandering Mabushina
videos.overview: Mabushiina wakes up to a trashed base and must piece together what she had done one step at a time.

videos.title: Rap
videos.overview: The Mashin prepare for a Crystalian holiday when Kurantula attacks the city through rap.

videos.title: Sena 1/5
videos.overview: Yodonna is sent in search of the king when she accidentally splits Sena into five separate people!

videos.title: Under Uncle's Moon
videos.overview: The Kiramager enter a battle with a monster that gives them cavities while Takamichi leaves to meet up with his uncle over a contest that they were never allowed to finish.

videos.title: The Emperor Is a Sniper
videos.overview: Takamichi buys Mabushiina a ring for her coming-of-age when they are caught in the crosshairs of a Yodom sniper.

videos.title: The Pained
videos.overview: Juuru meets a boy on a drawing website and wants to learn to draw like him.

videos.title: I Want to Be as I Am
videos.overview: Yodonna is fed up with Kurantula's pouting when he creates a monster that turns half of the Kiramager into cats!

videos.title: A Battle Without Honor and Humanity
videos.overview: Juuru dreams of the king again when his school gets taken over by a fog that is turning people into monsters.

videos.title: The Dirty Hero
videos.overview: The Kiramager plan to use Kurantula to go to Yodomheim and save the king.

videos.title: Rest in Peace, My Friend
videos.overview: The Kiramager must set aside their tears and focus on taking out Emperor Yodom once and for all.

videos.title: You Were There, and Shined
videos.overview: The Kiramager continue their final fight against Emperor Yodom to protect the Earth.
